gmail.name: search_threads
gmail.description: Search mail threads with Gmail search syntax (from:, to:, is:unread, newer_than:2d, has:attachment, subject:...). Returns each thread's subject, sender, date and snippet.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

gmail.name: get_thread
gmail.description: Read a whole thread: every message's sender, date, subject, text and attachments.

gmail.name: get_message
gmail.description: Read one message: sender, date, subject, text and attachments.

gmail.name: get_attachment
gmail.description: Read an attachment's text (PDF and text files) by the attachmentId that get_message or get_thread listed.

gmail.name: list_labels
gmail.description: The mailbox's labels, with the inbox's total and unread counts.

gmail.name: send_message
gmail.description: Send an email from the owner's Gmail. to, cc and bcc are email addresses; "me" is the owner's own. To answer a message, pass its messageId as replyToMessageId: the email goes into that thread, and the subject defaults to the original's with Re:. body is plain text.

contacts.name: search_contacts
contacts.description: Find people by name, email or phone in the owner's Google contacts, and among the people they have emailed. Returns names, email addresses, phone numbers and organizations.

calendar.name: list_events
calendar.description: Events between startTime and endTime, soonest first, recurring events as single occurrences, each tagged with its calendar. Default: every calendar the owner sees except holidays (a calendarId reads that one only), from now, 7 days.

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

calendar.name: search_events
calendar.description: Find events on the primary calendar by words in the title, description, place or attendees, from a year ago on, soonest first.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

calendar.name: suggest_time
calendar.description: Free slots of at least durationMinutes between startTime and endTime, busy time taken from every calendar the owner sees except holidays, within working hours (default 9 to 18).

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

calendar.name: create_event

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).

calendar.name: quick_add_event
calendar.description: Create an event from one plain sentence, the way Google Calendar's quick add reads it: "Lunch with Ana Friday 12pm at Zuni".

calendar.name: update_event

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).
